tool_input.description: Wait for acme-reporting build 1425 dev-cdk deploy to reach a terminal state
tool_input.command:
set -a; . ~/.secrets; set +a
while true; do
  resp=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $BUILDKITE_ACCESS_TOKEN" "https://api.buildkite.com/v2/organizations/acme/pipelines/acme-reporting/builds/1425")
  state=$(echo "$resp" | python3 -c "import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['state'])")
  case "$state" in passed|failed|canceled|blocked) echo "$state"; break;; esac
  sleep 30
done
